FROM python:3.10
RUN pip install pytest
RUN git clone https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown.git
RUN mkdir /repo
RUN git config --global --add safe.directory /repo
RUN cp -r /markitdown/. /repo && rm -rf /markitdown/
RUN rm -rf /markitdown

WORKDIR /repo

# Install the markitdown package with all optional dependencies plus plugins
RUN pip install -e "/repo/packages/markitdown[all]" \
    -e /repo/packages/markitdown-ocr \
    -e /repo/packages/markitdown-sample-plugin \
    -e /repo/packages/markitdown-mcp

# Configure pytest to use importlib mode to avoid conflicts between the multiple
# "tests" packages in the monorepo
RUN printf '[pytest]\naddopts = --import-mode=importlib\n' > /repo/pytest.ini

CMD ["pytest", "/repo", "--collect-only", "-q"]
